title: Save a given AppleScript as Documents/sum.scpt

source.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0; ported by reference (our own instruction, script, setup and checks; no source text copied)
source.changes: Instruction and script written by us: a loop that adds the numbers from 1 to N, where the source's loop went from 0 to 100. N is a param; 100, whose sum (5050) is the value the source checks, is one pick. The source started from a clean AMI snapshot; here setup moves an existing Documents/sum.scpt aside and teardown puts it back. The check is the source's (run the saved file with osascript), made exact instead of a grep.

setup.why: Move any sum.scpt already in Documents aside, so the file the check runs can only be the agent's.

instruction:
Save this AppleScript as sum.scpt in my Documents folder:

set total to 0
repeat with i from 1 to {{n.top}}
	set total to total + i
end repeat
return total

checks.why: ~/Documents/sum.scpt exists and, run with osascript, returns {{n.want}}, the sum of 1 to {{n.top}}. Setup moved any such file aside, so an agent that does nothing fails.

teardown.why: Quit Script Editor without saving, delete the run's file and put back the one setup moved aside.

oracle.why: Compile the script to ~/Documents/sum.scpt, as Script Editor's Save does.

argv: osacompile -o "$HOME/Documents/sum.scpt" -e 'set total to 0' -e 'repeat with i from 1 to {{n.top}}' -e 'set total to total + i' -e 'end repeat' -e 'return total'
